moisture_pct.quote: The average moisture value of Beyaz cheese samples was determined as 61.36% (Table 1).

fat_pct.quote: The average fat value of Beyaz cheese samples was determined as 15.29% (Table 1).

salt_pct.quote: The average salt value of Beyaz cheese samples was determined as 1.362% (Table 1).

ph.quote: The pH of Beyaz cheese samples was determined as the lowest at 4.30, the highest at 6.67 and the average at 5.75 (Table 1).

ammonia.reason: Limited deamination during 3-month 4C brine storage; low proteolysis yields little NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole/skatole absent in pasteurized cow milk and clean Lactococcus brine ripening.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic rennet peptides from alpha-s1-casein plus NaCl brine accentuates bitterness at low pH.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium; low 2-heptanone/2-nonanone (~8-14 ug/100g) from beta-oxidation, not mold.

browning.reason: High-moisture low-pH non-melting curd with little residual sugar inhibits Maillard browning.

buttery.reason: Moderate diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by Lactococcus lactis, limited by brine and low fat.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low butyric (2.7 mg/kg) and hexanoic acids from milk lipase and starter lipolysis in 90-d ripening.

creaminess.reason: Low fat 15% (~39% fat-in-dry-matter) and acid curd limits milkfat globule cream coating.

crumbliness.reason: Low-pH demineralized casein network stored in brine fractures without cohesion, typical feta-type.

firmness.reason: High moisture ~61% but acid-rennet gel firmed by 12-14% NaCl brine gives semi-soft sliceable body.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol not detected; limited phenylalanine catabolism in short brine aging.

fruity.reason: Low ethyl butanoate (~0.3 ug/100g) and ethyl octanoate from esterification by lactococci.

goaty.reason: Very low caproic/caprylic free fatty acids (~0.5-1.7 mg/kg) and cow milk with no goat branched-chain acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Trace 3-methylbutanal (0.03-0.11 ug/100g) from leucine Strecker degradation by lactococci.

melt.reason: Acidified low-pH high-salt casein does not flow; calcium-depleted para-casein only softens on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one not detected; no mold or linoleic acid lipoxygenase pathway.

oil_off.reason: Low total fat 15% entrapped in brine-swollen protein matrix releases almost no free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked curd and brine; guaiacol and phenols absent.

sour_vinegar.reason: High acetic (20-38 mg/100g) plus lactic acid from mesophilic Lactococcus fermentation, pH ~4.8-5.7.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata; no hot-water kneading and low pH/high salt prevents fibrous casein alignment.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Only trace methanethiol trend from methionine catabolism; pasteurized uncooked curd gives no H2S.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose depleted by starter; little lactose/galactose remains for sweetness.

umami.reason: Moderate glutamate release from rennet and lactococcal peptidase proteolysis over 60-100 days.
